01
💬

Real Conversation Practice

Have actual conversations with Claude in any of 8 languages. Not scripted dialogues — real exchanges where Claude responds to exactly what you say, corrects your mistakes naturally mid-conversation, and keeps the dialogue flowing.

Try it
"Let's practice a job interview in French. Correct my grammar as we go."
02
✏️

Instant Error Correction

Make a mistake and Claude corrects you immediately — explaining why, showing the right form, and using it in three memorable example sentences. No judgment. As many attempts as you need.

Try it
"Why was that wrong? Show me three more examples of that rule."
03
📖

Context Vocabulary

Words learned in isolation are words forgotten by day. Claude teaches vocabulary through stories, conversations, and real situations — the way children naturally acquire language. Retention is 3x higher.

Try it
"Teach me 10 business words in German using them in realistic workplace scenarios."
04
🎯

Adaptive Difficulty

SAIRN NEXUS style learning tracks every session. Claude knows what trips you up and focuses there — getting harder only when you are genuinely ready. No time wasted on things you already know.

Try it
"I struggle with Spanish subjunctive. Quiz me until I truly understand it."
05
🌍

Cultural Intelligence

Language without culture is just words. Claude teaches you what to say, when to say it, what it means when a native says it to you — including idioms, humor, regional differences, and social nuance no textbook covers.

Try it
"What phrases do people in Brazil actually use that textbooks never teach?"
06
🎤

Voice Practice Mode

Speak your responses using SAIRN NEXUS voice mode. Claude evaluates your word choice and phrasing, suggesting what sounds natural vs textbook-perfect — the difference between being understood and sounding like a local.

Try it
"I'll speak my response. Tell me how to make it sound more natural."

'\nWho they are: ' + memory.summary : ''; return '\n\nWHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW ABOUT THIS USER (learned across all SAIRN apps):\n' + facts + summary + '\n\nUse this naturally — just let it make your help more personal.'; } catch(e) { return ''; } } async function extractMemoryOrig() { const token = localStorage.getItem('sairn_token'); if (!token || !hist || hist.length < 2) return; try { fetch('https://sairn.vercel.app/api/memory', { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+token}, body:JSON.stringify({action:'extract',messages:hist.slice(-10),app_id:APP_ID||'unknown'}) }); } catch(e) {} } window.addEventListener('beforeunload', extractMemoryOrig); let lastBubText = ''; function showSaveBar(content) { const existing = document.getElementById('sairn-save-bar'); if (existing) existing.remove(); lastBubText = content; const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.id = 'sairn-save-bar'; bar.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:80px;right:20px;background:#1A1C32;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:999;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'; bar.innerHTML = '' + '' + ''; document.body.appendChild(bar); setTimeout(()=>{ const b=document.getElementById('sairn-save-bar'); if(b)b.remove(); }, 8000); }
